name: giljo-hq
description: Giljo HQ is a project-management and agent-coordination server for small software teams. It exposes your team's working context (products, projects, tasks, a roadmap, and a durable cross-session memory) over the Model Context Protocol, so your AI coding agent can read real project context and file its own work back into it instead of starting from a blank slate every session. Connect it to ChatGPT or Codex, and your agent can: create and update projects and tasks against your actual roadmap; stage a project for implementation through a human-in-the-loop approval gate before any code is written; record durable memory entries so decisions and context survive across sessions; and coordinate with other agents working the same codebase through a shared message hub. Giljo HQ is a commercial product sold by GILJOAI LLC. Each user signs in with their own Giljo HQ account, and every tool call reads and writes only that user's private workspace.

defaultPrompt: Run giljo_setup, then show me what Giljo HQ can do.
Show my projects and tasks. If I have none, help me set up a product and add my first project.
Post a hello note in the message hub for my coding agents to pick up.
